anomalies.description: A large explosion erupts from the entrance of a snow-covered mountain bunker, producing bright orange fire and expanding smoke plume.

A large, sustained explosion erupts from a structure embedded in a snow-covered mountain, growing in intensity and scale over time, with fire, smoke, and debris ejection visible across multiple frames.

A large, violent explosion erupts from a structure on a snowy cliff edge, producing a massive fireball, intense white-yellow flash, and ejection of debris (e.g., panels, beams) outward and upward. The explosion rapidly expands and peaks in intensity between frames f0–f5.; The explosion transitions into a sustained, large-scale fireball and burning debris field on the cliff top; the initial blast wave has subsided but intense combustion continues with visible flames, smoke, and residual ejecta settling. This is the aftermath phase of the same explosive event, not a new detonation.

A large, sustained explosion erupts on a snow-covered cliff edge, with fire and debris expanding outward over multiple frames; the blast appears to originate from a fixed point and evolves dynamically through the sequence.
